build_export_onnx_model: export a SAM model checkpoint to an ONNX file with configurable opset and model type
run_export_onnx_model: run export of a SAM prompt encoder and mask decoder to ONNX with dynamic axes for point inputs
quantize_onnx_model: quantize an exported ONNX SAM model to QUInt8 weights using onnxruntime quantize_dynamic
test_onnx_model: test an exported ONNX SAM model by running inference with ONNXRuntime CPU provider
summarize_export_onnx_model: summarize the export_onnx_model script that converts SAM checkpoints to ONNX format
